message: `aria-busy="true"` on the `<div>` above it sets the live region of `warning` otherwise than its role does
$reason: A warning part in an `<ng-template>` declared inside a wrapper written `aria-busy="true"`, its outlet beside it in the same wrapper, which stamps the part busy there (Firefox 158 hands it `container-busy="true"`, measured on 2026-10-27). What sets a part's region is read where the template is declared, as what may hide it is; point 9's reset of `aria-hidden` at a template is not taken over. Point 7 read nothing above the part but what may hide it, and passed it.
